question: Has the use case been screened against the organization's prohibited and restricted AI use policy?
recommended_action: Screen the use case against the prohibited/restricted AI use list and record the outcome; escalate any match for legal review.
evidence_expected: Intake screening record against prohibited/restricted use list

question: Is the system's data access limited to the minimum records and fields it needs (e.g. field-level scoping of CRM access)?
recommended_action: Restrict data access to the minimum records and fields required, using scoped service identities, and review access periodically.
evidence_expected: Access-scope configuration; Field-level access matrix; Access review record

question: Are retention periods defined and enforced for prompts, outputs, conversation transcripts and logs?
recommended_action: Define and enforce retention periods for prompts, outputs, transcripts and logs consistent with the privacy assessment.
evidence_expected: Retention schedule covering AI artefacts; Deletion job configuration or records

question: Is the human oversight design documented — who reviews which outputs or actions, when, and with authority to override or stop the system?
recommended_action: Document the oversight design (reviewer roles, review points, override and stop authority) and keep records of oversight in operation.
evidence_expected: Oversight design document; Override/appeal procedures; Oversight operation records

question: Has a privacy / data-protection impact assessment been completed covering lawful basis, minimisation, retention and cross-border transfers?
recommended_action: Complete a privacy impact assessment (DPIA where required) covering lawful basis, minimisation, retention and transfers, signed off by the DPO/privacy lead.
evidence_expected: Privacy/data-protection impact assessment; Retention schedule; Transfer assessment

question: Are personal and sensitive fields redacted or masked before they reach prompts, logs and external model calls?
recommended_action: Deploy redaction/masking on prompts, responses, logs and external model calls; test it against representative records and retain the results.
evidence_expected: Redaction configuration; Redaction test results; Log samples showing masking

question: Is there a tested kill switch and rollback procedure that can disable the system, model, agent or individual tools quickly?
recommended_action: Implement and test a kill switch and rollback runbook; record time-to-disable from the test.
evidence_expected: Kill-switch procedure; Kill-switch test record with time-to-disable; Rollback runbook

question: Are the intended purpose, context of use, users, affected parties and out-of-scope uses documented?
recommended_action: Document intended purpose, context of use, users, affected parties and explicitly out-of-scope or foreseeable misuse.
evidence_expected: System profile with intended purpose; Users and affected parties; Foreseeable misuse analysis

question: Have the legal, regulatory and contractual obligations that apply to this system (by jurisdiction) been identified and reviewed?
recommended_action: Add the system to the obligations register and obtain a legal review of applicable obligations by jurisdiction.
evidence_expected: Obligations register entry for this system; Legal review record

question: Are changes to the model, prompts, data, tools or vendor subject to change control with defined reassessment triggers?
recommended_action: Add AI-specific change triggers (model, prompt, data, tool, vendor) to change management and require reassessment when they fire.
evidence_expected: Change policy with AI-specific triggers; Change tickets referencing reassessment; Model/prompt version history

question: Are the data sources, classifications and data flows used for training, grounding (RAG) and prompts documented for this system?
recommended_action: Document every data source, its classification and the data flows into prompts, retrieval indexes, logs and external services.
evidence_expected: Data source register entries; Data-flow diagram; Data classification per source

question: Do models, prompts, plugins and third-party components come from an approved, integrity-checked supply chain?
recommended_action: Restrict models and components to an approved list with integrity checks and dependency scanning.
evidence_expected: Approved model/provider list; Integrity checks; Dependency scanning results

question: Were pre-release validation and robustness tests run against documented acceptance criteria, with results retained?
recommended_action: Define acceptance criteria, run pre-release validation and robustness tests, and retain signed-off results.
evidence_expected: Test plan and results; Acceptance criteria; Release sign-off

question: Can affected individuals obtain an explanation, reach a human, and contest or appeal outcomes?
recommended_action: Provide a route to a human, explanations proportionate to impact, and a contest/appeal channel whose outcomes are logged.
evidence_expected: Explanation approach; Feedback channel; Feedback log

question: Are operators and reviewers trained on the system's limitations, automation bias and escalation paths?
owner_role: HR / Learning lead with AI Governance Lead
recommended_action: Deliver role-based training for operators and reviewers covering limitations, automation bias and escalation, and track completion.
evidence_expected: Training curriculum; Completion records by role

question: Is there a defined escalation path for concerns and AI incidents involving this system?
recommended_action: Define and communicate an escalation path and incident procedure for this system, with named contacts and timeframes.
evidence_expected: Escalation matrix; AI incident procedure; Sample escalation records

question: Were go-live deployment conditions defined, verified and signed off before production use?
recommended_action: Define go-live conditions (controls, monitoring, oversight) and verify them with a signed checklist before production use.
evidence_expected: Go-live checklist; Condition verification record

question: Was vendor AI due diligence completed for the model/service provider (security, data use, model training on your data, subprocessors)?
recommended_action: Complete AI-specific vendor due diligence covering security, data use, training on customer data and subprocessors.
evidence_expected: Vendor AI questionnaire; Due-diligence approval

question: Do contract terms cover data-use restrictions, no training on your data, retention, breach notification and audit rights?
recommended_action: Negotiate or confirm AI contract clauses for data use, training restrictions, retention, breach notification and audit rights.
evidence_expected: Contract AI clauses; Responsibility allocation (e.g. RACI or contract schedule)

question: Are vendor model version changes and deprecations monitored and routed through change control?
recommended_action: Monitor vendor model/version announcements and route changes through change control with reassessment triggers.
evidence_expected: Change tickets referencing reassessment; Model registry entries with versions

question: Is this system covered by an AI incident management procedure, including internal and external reporting timelines?
recommended_action: Bring the system under the AI incident procedure with defined severity levels and reporting timelines; Legal to confirm external reporting duties.
evidence_expected: AI incident procedure; Incident log; Post-incident reviews

question: Is evidence for this system's controls retained in an evidence repository, and can an audit-ready evidence pack be produced on request?
recommended_action: Store control evidence for this system in the evidence repository with retention rules and assemble an audit-ready evidence pack.
evidence_expected: Evidence repository; Retention policy; Sample evidence pack

question: Is technical documentation (system/model card, architecture, data, testing, limitations) maintained for this system?
recommended_action: Produce and maintain technical documentation including a system/model card, architecture, data, testing and known limitations.
evidence_expected: Technical documentation pack; Model/system card

question: Has the use case passed intake triage and received a risk tier that was confirmed by an accountable approver?
recommended_action: Run the use case through intake triage and record a human-confirmed risk tier with rationale in the intake register.
evidence_expected: Intake register entry; Triage decision with rationale; Tiering approval record

question: Has an AI-specific threat model been completed for this system (e.g. prompt injection, data poisoning, model abuse, tool misuse)?
recommended_action: Produce an AI-specific threat model covering injection, poisoning, abuse and tool misuse, and track mitigations to closure.
evidence_expected: Threat model document; Mitigation tracking

question: Has a safety and harm evaluation been completed (harmful, misleading or inappropriate outputs, including for vulnerable users)?
recommended_action: Complete a harm analysis and safety evaluation, including vulnerable-user scenarios, and obtain residual-risk sign-off.
evidence_expected: Harm analysis; Safety evaluation results; Residual-risk sign-off

question: Is production performance, drift and misuse monitored against thresholds with alerts and review?
recommended_action: Instrument performance, drift and misuse monitoring with thresholds, alerts and a recurring review.
evidence_expected: Monitoring dashboards; Alert thresholds; Monitoring review records

question: Is a periodic review / recertification of this system scheduled at the cadence required by its risk tier?
recommended_action: Schedule periodic review and recertification at the cadence set for the system's risk tier.
evidence_expected: Review calendar by tier; Recertification records

question: Was a pre-deployment risk and impact assessment completed and approved at the gate appropriate to the risk tier?
recommended_action: Complete a tier-proportionate risk and impact assessment and obtain approval at the tier-appropriate gate before (further) production use.
evidence_expected: Completed risk/impact assessment; Reviewer sign-off; Approval record with conditions; Residual-risk statement

question: Are people informed when they are interacting with AI or receiving AI-generated content?
recommended_action: Add clear AI-interaction and AI-generated-content disclosures at the point of interaction; have Legal review the wording.
evidence_expected: Disclosure text and placement; User-facing documentation
